meta.title: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials JEE results
meta.description: JEE results of D-SAP Ghule Tutorials students, each with the exam, the year and the programme taken, shared with the student's consent.

intro: Our students' JEE results, each with the details a parent needs to judge it: the exam, the year and the programme the student took with us.

sections.heading: Results
body: Each result shows the student's name, with their consent, the exam and year, the rank or percentile, and the programme they took with us.

sections.heading: How we report results
body: A result on this page follows four rules.
points: We show only results we can check, and only with the student's consent.
Each result names the exam and the year.
Each result names the programme the student took with us, and for how long.
A student who took only a test series with us is not shown as if they took the full programme.
